regions.merged_text: "I am the mother of fair love an fear, and of knowledge and of holy (Eccles, 24-24.) In me is all grace of the way and of the truth, in me is all hope of life and of virtue. "A simple prudence and a prudent simplicity" Beatification Process of St. Frances Cabrini. "Generous as she was, she was neverthless careful not to waste a button or a pin.
